title: Support
items: What does Call Home do when a software or hardware error occurs?
Notifies the support center and automatically opens a service request
Sends a text message to hosts
Call Home 在發生軟硬體錯誤時通知支援中心，並自動開啟 Service Request。
Which port does Call Home with cloud services use to send data to IBM Support?
Call Home with Cloud Services 經由 443 Port 將資料送到 IBM Support 的集中 Repository。
What is the advantage of Call Home with cloud services?
Data goes directly to a centralized repository and support personnel are automatically assigned
It does not need internet access
It replaces email for all users
Cloud Services 直接送到集中的檔案 Repository，支援人員自動被指派問題。
What role does Call Home with email notifications play?
A backup method that notifies support and local users through an email server
Email Notifications 經 Email Server 通知支援與本地使用者，可作為備援。
Which prerequisite applies to Call Home with cloud services?
All nodes can reach the internet and each node has a valid service IP
Only the configuration node needs internet
所有 Node 都要能連上網際網路，且每個 Node 已設定有效的 Service IP。
If an SSL inspection proxy is used for Call Home, what must be done?
Define the proxy and add its SSL certificate
若使用 SSL Inspection Proxy，須定義 Proxy 並加入其 SSL 憑證。
Where is Call Home configured in the GUI?
設定位置為 Settings > Support > Call Home。
Which roles are assigned to support personnel during local support assistance?
Local Support Assistance 的支援人員登入時被指派 Monitor 或 Restricted Administrator 角色。
Which action can a Restricted Administrator NOT perform?
Restricted Administrator 不可刪除 Volume 或 Pool、Unmap Host，或建立、刪除、變更使用者。
What is required before configuring remote support assistance?
Local support assistance must be configured and Call Home must be set up
Remote Support Assistance 須先設定 Local Support Assistance，並已設定 Call Home。
Which support package type contains only standard logs and is the smallest and fastest to upload?
Type 1 為 Standard Logs (含 Event Log、Audit Log 與 /var/log/messages)，檔案最小、上傳最快。
What does a Type 2 support package contain?
Standard logs plus one existing statesave
Standard logs plus the latest statesave from each node
Standard logs plus new statesaves from all nodes
Type 2 為 Standard Logs 加一份既有 Statesave (Dump 或 Livedump)。
Which support package type includes new statesaves (livedumps) generated from all nodes?
Type 4 為 Standard Logs 加所有 Node 新產生的 Statesave (Livedump)。
What does a Type 3 support package contain?
Standard logs plus the most recent statesave from each node
Standard logs plus one existing statesave
Type 3 為 Standard Logs 加每個 Node 最近一次的 Statesave。
What is required to upload a support package?
上傳 Support Package 需至少一台 DNS Server；所有 Support Assistance 動作都會記錄供 Audit。
Which interface is used for day-to-day management and fix procedures from Monitoring > Events?
Management GUI 用於日常管理與 Monitoring > Events 的 Fix Procedure，Expansion Enclosure 也只能在 GUI 服務。
Where can expansion enclosures be serviced?
Expansion Enclosure 只能在 Management GUI 中服務，Service Assistant 不能服務 Expansion Enclosure。
Does the CLI provide fix procedures?
CLI 沒有 Fix Procedure，適合進階使用者處理 GUI 沒有的設定或指令碼。
When should the service assistant be used?
When a node is in service state, the GUI is unavailable, or a fix procedure directs you
Node 在 service state、GUI 無法使用或 Fix Procedure 指示時使用 Service Assistant。
When is a USB flash drive useful as a service interface?
When you cannot reach the service assistant, do not know the service IP, or forgot the superuser password
For uploading support packages to IBM
USB Flash Drive 適用於無法連上 Service Assistant、不知道 Service IP 或忘記 superuser 密碼時。
Which port do service interfaces connect through on each canister?
服務介面透過各 Canister Port 1 的 1 Gbps Ethernet 連接。
How do you open the service assistant in a browser?
Open the service IP followed by /service
Open the management IP followed by /gui
瀏覽器開啟 Service IP 加 /service；也可用 Management IP 加 /service 進入 Configuration Node。
What is the default password for a brand-new node canister in the service assistant?
全新 Node Canister 的預設密碼是 passw0rd，以 superuser 登入。
What is the default service IP for canister 1 port 1?
預設 Service IP：Canister 1 Port 1 為 192.168.70.121、Canister 2 為 192.168.70.122，Mask 255.255.255.0。
In the service assistant, how do you run actions on a different node?
Log in again with the node name
指令在 Current Node 執行，左上角顯示其資訊，以 Change Node 切換。
What happens when you use Exit Service State in the service assistant?
The node returns to candidate and automatically rejoins the system
The node reboots into service mode
Exit Service State 讓 Node 回到 candidate 並自動加入系統。
Which file does the node read from the root of a USB flash drive?
Node 讀取根目錄的 satask.txt，檔案只能有一行、一個指令，讀取後即刪除。
Where does the node write the results of a USB command?
結果與 Node 狀態寫入 satask_result.html，新結果插在最前面。
What file system must the first partition of the USB flash drive use?
USB Flash Drive 的第一個分割區必須為 FAT32。
When is it safe to remove the USB flash drive?
When the fault LED stops flashing
When the power LED turns off
Fault LED 閃爍表示執行中，停止閃爍後才可拔除。
How should a computer be connected to the technician port?
Directly with a standard 1 Gbps Ethernet cable, not through a switch
Technician Port 位於機箱背面，用標準 1 Gbps Ethernet 線直連電腦，不能經過 Switch。
If the computer connected to the technician port uses DHCP, which address do you browse?
電腦設為 DHCP 時瀏覽 service.internal；沒有 DHCP 時電腦設 192.168.0.2 並瀏覽 192.168.0.1。
When does the technician port show the initialization tool?
When the node is candidate and its partner is not active
Node 為 candidate 且 Partner 不是 active 時顯示 Initialization Tool，否則顯示 Service Assistant。
When should you NOT use the initialization tool?
When the system already has an active node
When setting up a new system
系統內已有 active Node 時，不要使用 Initialization Tool。
If you can log in to the GUI, where do you find the service IP addresses?
能登入 GUI 時，Service IP 位於 Settings > Network > Service IP Addresses。
Where can the management IP address be found if you can access the service assistant?
On the service assistant home page
Management IP 會顯示在 Service Assistant 首頁，也可由 USB 回傳資料取得。
What does Download Support Package in the GUI collect?
Data for all components of the system
GUI 的 Settings > Support > Download Support Package 涵蓋全系統所有元件；Service Assistant 的 Collect Logs 只收集目前 Node。
What is the packaged support data file called?
打包後的檔案稱為 Snap，內容需 Support 專用工具判讀。
Which command collects a snap and can upload it with a PMR?
USB 或 Service CLI 可用 `satask snap`，另可指定 -upload 與 -pmr 上傳。
What can a USB flash drive reset that requires physical access to the node for identity verification?
The service IP and superuser password
USB 可重設 Service IP 與 superuser 密碼，需實際接觸 Node 以驗證身分。
What happens if no satask.txt exists on the USB flash drive?
Status data is still written, which can show the management and service IPs
即使沒有 satask.txt，也會寫入狀態資料，可用來查 Management IP 與 Service IP。
Which service assistant function lets you modify a node's WWNN?
The node status and error view
Service Assistant 可查看 Node Error 與狀態並修改 WWNN。
Which service assistant action re-installs node software from another node?
Service Assistant 可 Re-install Software，或從另一個 Node Rescue。
What happens to your service assistant session when an action restarts the node canister?
The connection is interrupted and you must log in again
The session moves to the partner
會讓 Node Canister 重新啟動的動作會中斷連線，需重新登入。
What can the service CLI be used for?
Advanced single-node service tasks, though the service assistant is usually easier
Service CLI 針對單一 Node，適合進階使用者；一般使用 Service Assistant 較容易。
What risk exists with service actions?
Improper use can cause loss of access to data or data loss
Service Action 使用不當可能造成資料無法存取或遺失。
If nodes cannot communicate with each other, how should you find a node's details?
Connect directly to that node's service assistant
Node 之間無法通訊時，直接連到該 Node 的 Service Assistant；仍找不到則改用 Technician Port 或 USB。
Which address and protocol let you use the CLI through the technician port?
也可 SSH 到 192.168.0.1，以 superuser 使用 CLI。
Yes, all support assistance actions are recorded for audit
所有 Support Assistance 動作都會記錄供 Audit。
How does the system use Call Home and email together?
Cloud services is primary; email notifications act as a backup
Email is required and cloud is optional
Call Home 以 Cloud Services 為主，Email Notifications 可作為備援。
